Our story

Personal relationships.
Global possibilities.

Geojit Private Wealth (DIFC) Limited is an independent wealth management firm headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre.

We bring together Geojit’s investment heritage and the regional experience of Barjeel Geojit Financial Services LLC to serve internationally connected individuals, families and businesses.

Our approach starts with understanding your priorities, then bringing a wider perspective to the decisions ahead.

Our journey · 1987–2026

From a first step
to a global perspective.

Explore the milestones that shaped Geojit, from a garage in Ravipuram to Private Wealth in DIFC.

1987

Milestone 01 / 12

An entrepreneurial beginning

Established M/s C J George and Co., a proprietary firm at Ravipuram, in a garage converted into an office.

1995

Milestone 02 / 12

Becoming a public limited company

Geojit and Co. became a public limited company and was named Geojit Securities Ltd.

1997

Milestone 03 / 12

Portfolio management takes shape

Launched Portfolio Management Services with SEBI registration.

2000

Milestone 04 / 12

Pioneering internet trading

Geojit launched India’s first internet trading facility.

2001

Milestone 05 / 12

Building connections in the UAE

Geojit signed an MoU with Barjeel Shares and Bonds LLC, a part of Al Saud Group, UAE.

2006

Milestone 06 / 12

A global banking partnership

Geojit joined hands with French banking giant BNP Paribas.

2010

Milestone 07 / 12

Trading goes mobile

Launched FLIP ME, India’s first mobile trading app.

2015

Milestone 08 / 12

An advanced trading experience

Launched a new advanced trading platform, SELFIE.

2017

Milestone 09 / 12

A dedicated private wealth division

Established Geojit’s Private Wealth Services Division.

2023

Milestone 10 / 12

A gateway to global investments

Established Geojit IFSC at GIFT City for global investments.

2025

Milestone 11 / 12

Expanding into alternative investments

Launched Alternative Investment Fund (AIF), Geojit Yield Plus.

2026

Milestone 12 / 12

A new chapter in DIFC

Geojit Private Wealth DIFC was launched.
